messages.label: Step 0 (listening_phase1) progress trigger — advances to listening_phase2_a. Cond: service_id == 0xFFFF and sd_entry_count >= 1 and sd_entries[0].type == 0x01 and sd_entries[0].service_id == expected.service_id

Step 1 (listening_phase2_a) progress trigger — advances to listening_phase2_b. Cond: service_id == expected.service_id and src_port == expected.tcp_port and message_type == 0x80 and method_id == 0x000A and return_code == 0x0…

Step 2 (listening_phase2_b) progress trigger — advances to listening_phase2_c. Cond: service_id == expected.service_id and src_port == expected.tcp_port and message_type == 0x80 and method_id == 0x000A and return_code == 0x0…

Step 3 (listening_phase2_c) pass trigger — transitions to pass. Cond: service_id == expected.service_id and src_port == expected.tcp_port and message_type == 0x80 and method_id == 0x000A and return_code == 0x0…
